glyph_origin: Phono-semantic (形聲) and ideogrammic compound (會意): a person (亻) carrying a quiver (𤰈 OC *bɯɡ) – "ready; prepared".
s_page_origin: Simplified from 俻 (亻 →), a variant of 備. Officially adopted as the simplified form of 備 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
senses: [bèi] to provide or prepare against; to take precautions against
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 備; s_page_origin explains the simplified 备.
